levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط
داود بن عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: «أبيه» is the father of داود with no name: a relation. The father's own account of the scene in Ibn Umar's house carries Abu Hurayra's words («إنه سمع رسول الله»), so Abu Hurayra is the last link (rule 6).
Khabbab is the messenger in the scene and Aisha's confirmation («صدق أبو هريرة») is inside the story, not separate routes.
